name: latex-inline
description: Typesets the LaTeX math in Claude's replies as pictures inside the terminal, inline with the text, in Ghostty, cmux and kitty

mode.title: When to draw math
mode.description: auto draws only in terminals that show kitty-graphics pictures (Ghostty, cmux, kitty; not inside tmux). on draws everywhere, off never.

teach_claude.title: Tell Claude to write math in LaTeX
teach_claude.description: Adds a short section to the system prompt, only where math is drawn, asking Claude to write formulas as $...$ and $$...$$.

node_path.title: Node.js executable
node_path.description: The node that runs the renderer, as a command on PATH or an absolute path.

cell_aspect.title: Cell height over width
cell_aspect.description: Your terminal font's cell height divided by its width. 2.2 fits JetBrains Mono, Ghostty's default; 2.0 fits Fira Code. Formulas look stretched when it is off.

baseline.title: Baseline position
baseline.description: Where the text baseline sits in a cell, as a fraction of the cell height from the top: 0.773 for JetBrains Mono, 0.75 for Fira Code.

line_height.title: Cell height in ems
line_height.description: The cell height in ems of your terminal font: 1.32 for JetBrains Mono, 1.231 for Fira Code.

math_scale.title: Inline math size
math_scale.description: Inline formula size in ems of your terminal font. Formulas taller than a row take three rows instead of shrinking.

display_scale.title: Display math size
display_scale.description: Display formula ($$...$$) size in ems of your terminal font.

color.title: Math color
color.description: auto follows Claude Code's theme; or a #rrggbb color.
